metadata.label: Deaths by region, age and sex. Week 1999V52-2024V52
note: Deaths without a known day of death are not included in the statistics.

The statistics for the last calendar year are preliminary and will be revised until the statistics for the last complete week of the year (Monday to Sunday before the turn of the year) are published. Note that week 52/53 can be based on deaths both before and after the turn of the year and that the statistics for that week then are preliminary until the last complete week of the following year are published.
Statistict for 2025 and onwards are available here: [Deaths by region, age and sex. Year 2025–](https://www.statistikdatabasen.scb.se/pxweb/en/ssd/START__BE__BE0101__BE0101I/DodaVeckaRegionCKM/)

03: Since 1 January 2007, Uppsala county has been expanded to include Heby municipality. Please note that the figures for the county are not comparable with earlier figures.
0330: Since 1 January 2003, a new regional division has been established. Parts of Uppsala municipality (code 0380) have formed a new municipality called Knivsta (code 0330).
0331: Since 1 January 2007, Heby municipality has been transferred from Västmanland county to Uppsala county. The code for Heby has changed from 1917 to 0331.
0380: Since 1 January 2003, a new regional division has been established. Parts of Uppsala municipality (code 0380) have formed a new municipality called Knivsta (code 0330).
19: Since 1 January 2007, Västmanland county no longer includes Heby municipality. Please note that the figures for the county are not comparable with earlier figures.
